review.official:
Adnachiel is a citizen of
Laterano
and enjoys rights one through thirteen afforded to all citizens of Laterano. Before his arrival at
Rhodes Island
, he worked as a freelancer. He received excellent results on a battery of tests and was assigned to Rhodes Island Op Reserve Team A4.
He has demonstrated great potential in the areas of rapid response, marksmanship, and support operations.

files.description:
Imaging tests have shown the outlines of his internal organs to be indistinct due to abnormal shadows. Originium granules have been detected in his circulatory system, confirming him to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 9%
He presents no obvious external symptoms of Oripathy.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.26u/L
Degree of infection is minor and has not displayed any significant physical symptoms.

Operators familiar with Adnachiel tend to use one word to describe the angel: bright. No matter how complicated the subject or advanced the technology involved, he seems to have no trouble mastering it in a short period of time. 
In a show of humility, Adnachiel stands helpless in the face of loftier, theoretical topics, though everyone assumes he's just being modest. After all, as soft spoken and kind as he is, Adnachiel gives off the impression of being a clever and considerate young man. After meeting him, most operators come to understand his observant and sensitive personality. He always speaks to the true nature of things, but the scope of his theories is limited to that over which he has immediate control. Through his analyses, he can even predict the short-term future of his targets. He consistently rejects the titles of both 'prophet' and 'genius pretty boy,' but rumors about him continue to proliferate.

When he has free time between missions, Adnachiel often goes to the Rhodes Island Maintenance and Repair Workshop. Working as an intern assistant, Adnachiel's wrists are flexible and his attention to detail is meticulous. He has demonstrated an insatiable curiosity about Rhodes Island's equipment.

Adnachiel has not yet completed the Laterano Firearms Usage Agreement. His most trusted piece of equipment is his personally modified crossbow (Laterano crossbows are very different from the metal crossbows mass produced by Raythean). As he is not sufficiently physically strong, Adnachiel's crossbow has a pedal on the front used to help pull back the string with his foot.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: That device you're holding seems to be in poor shape. Would you mind if I take a look at it?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Hey, Ansel. Cardigan looks good today. Anything I can help you with?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: We have a squad of very interesting people, especially Melantha. She always seems to be hiding from me, but I can sniff her out.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Cardigan, what are you doing? You look so happy.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Not every Laterano has the right to use guns, rare weapons that they are. In my hometown, we're pretty good at making knockoff gun parts. The crossbow crafting industry is also on the rise. The result is what I have here - a crossbow with a tactical rail attachment.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Would you like to try some of my handmade sweets? I'm kind of ashamed that I can only make 25 types of desserts. It feels like I've disgraced the Laterano people.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: What's wrong with my halo? I don't know why, but it seems to have deviated slightly. According to Dr. Kal'tsit, it probably has something to do with my abnormal hippocampus.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Instead of watching you from afar, I feel much better standing by your side, Doctor.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor, you strike an impressive figure, even when you rest like that.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: My name is Adnachiel. I'm a Sniper from Laterano. Although I'm not yet certified to carry a gun, I can match the veterans with my crossbow!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Put me to good use and I'll be more than happy.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Thank you very much for the promotion.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: We will be fine.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: If anything breaks, bring it to me. I may be able to fix it for you.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: It's time to go. Are you ready?

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Let the hunt begin.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I will follow your orders.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: You better run away soon.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Okay!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Gotcha!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Locked on!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Everything went just as you planned, Doctor.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: We have the Doctor's orders to thank for this.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Our operation was a success, but something feels a bit off...

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I'm so sorry...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: This place has a great vibe.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: What?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor? I'm so happy to be with you!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Just like here, everyone would get together on this day to celebrate in Laterano. Some friends would even come visit just for the occasion, and see whether my halo was righted yet. Well, it's a shame I wasn't able to get my own gun before I left, but I guess I clicked with the crossbow anyhow. Slick of me, right?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: May the Lord bless you, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: I've learned how to make fifteen more desserts this year, and though that's a long way off from how many desserts Laterano has, it should be enough for you to choose your birthday cake. I'd lean towards a fruitcake or a raspberry mochi—sweet and delicious in spades.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Doctor, nothing's made me happier than getting to work with you so long. I can't count how much you've cared for my squad members over the past year. Whichever way you guide me, Doctor, that's the future I'll sprint for.
